execution.resumeStrategy: Each index is CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS; replay is safe.
execution.idempotency: No data mutation occurs. Existing pilot indexes are intentionally retained pending traffic evidence.

quarantine.strategy: Disable promoter feature flags if a deployment issue occurs; index changes do not alter financial or attribution records.

indexes: Covers the promoter foreign keys listed by the post-Phase-10 Performance Advisor.
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Rerun the Performance Advisor and confirm promoter unindexed_foreign_keys notices are absent; retain unused-index notices until pilot traffic permits a meaningful usage decision.

recovery.rollback: Retain indexes through pilot; any removal is a separately reviewed, non-emergency migration.
recovery.forwardFix: Add a specifically justified covering index if a new advisor finding appears.
